+class TestSplitArrayByHalfSum(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Test the _split_array_by_half_sum function for balanced splitting."""
+
+    def test_balanced_array(self):
+        """Test with a balanced array."""
+        arr = [10, 10, 10, 10]
+        split_index = _split_array_by_half_sum(arr)
+        sum_first = sum(arr[:split_index])
+        sum_second = sum(arr[split_index:])
+        self.assertEqual(split_index, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(sum_first, 20)
+        self.assertEqual(sum_second, 20)
+
+    def test_imbalanced_array_large_element(self):
+        """Test with imbalanced array where one element is much larger."""
+        arr = [40, 30, 30]
+        split_index = _split_array_by_half_sum(arr)
+        sum_first = sum(arr[:split_index])
+        sum_second = sum(arr[split_index:])
+        # Should split at index 1: [40] vs [30, 30] = 40 vs 60
+        # This is better than [40, 30] vs [30] = 70 vs 30
+        self.assertEqual(split_index, 1)
+        self.assertLess(abs(sum_first - sum_second), 30)
+
+    def test_imbalanced_array_very_large_last_element(self):
+        """Test with very large last element."""
+        arr = [10, 10, 10, 70]
+        split_index = _split_array_by_half_sum(arr)
+        sum_first = sum(arr[:split_index])
+        sum_second = sum(arr[split_index:])
+        # Should split at index 3: [10, 10, 10] vs [70] = 30 vs 70
+        self.assertEqual(split_index, 3)
+
+    def test_imbalanced_array_large_middle_element(self):
+        """Test with large middle element."""
+        arr = [10, 60, 30]
+        split_index = _split_array_by_half_sum(arr)
+        sum_first = sum(arr[:split_index])
+        sum_second = sum(arr[split_index:])
+        # Should split at index 2: [10, 60] vs [30] = 70 vs 30
+        # This is better than [10] vs [60, 30] = 10 vs 90
+        self.assertEqual(split_index, 2)
+
+    def test_two_element_array(self):
+        """Test with two elements."""
+        arr = [30, 70]
+        split_index = _split_array_by_half_sum(arr)
+        self.assertEqual(split_index, 1)
+
+    def test_small_first_large_rest(self):
+        """Test with small first element and large rest."""
+        arr = [5, 45, 50]
+        split_index = _split_array_by_half_sum(arr)
+        sum_first = sum(arr[:split_index])
+        sum_second = sum(arr[split_index:])
+        # Should prefer the split that's closer to 50
+        # [5] vs [45, 50] = 5 vs 95 (distance = 90)
+        # [5, 45] vs [50] = 50 vs 50 (distance = 0)
+        self.assertEqual(split_index, 2)
+        self.assertEqual(sum_first, 50)
+        self.assertEqual(sum_second, 50)
+
+    def test_multiple_small_one_large(self):
+        """Test with multiple small elements and one large."""
+        arr = [5, 5, 5, 5, 80]
+        split_index = _split_array_by_half_sum(arr)
+        sum_first = sum(arr[:split_index])
+        sum_second = sum(arr[split_index:])
+        # Total = 100, half = 50
+        # Should split at index 4: [5, 5, 5, 5] vs [80] = 20 vs 80
+        self.assertEqual(split_index, 4)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
